demographics.household: Dual-income family with kids and pets

psychographics_and_mindset.mindset_or_philosophy: I want to do it all but I physically cannot keep up with everything
fears_and_anxieties: Being judged for a messy home
psychographics_and_mindset.ideal_future_state: Come home to a clean house and happy pets without lifting a finger

top_pain_points: Never enough time to keep the house clean
Guilt about pets being home alone all day
Weekends consumed by catch-up cleaning instead of family time
Juggling multiple service providers for different needs

cost_of_problem.time: 10+ hours per week on cleaning and pet care
cost_of_problem.money: No cost yet -- doing it themselves at expense of free time

goals_and_desired_outcomes.primary_goal: Reclaim weekends and evenings by outsourcing home and pet care

buying_signals: Falling behind on cleaning after a busy week
Pet showing signs of boredom or restlessness
Recommendation from a friend or neighbor

demographics.household: Single professional or couple with dogs and/or cats

psychographics_and_mindset.mindset_or_philosophy: My pet deserves the best care even when I cannot be there
aspirations: Pet that is happy and well-exercised
psychographics_and_mindset.ideal_future_state: Peace of mind knowing their pet is walked, fed, and loved while they work or travel

top_pain_points: Long work hours leaving pet alone
Travel for work with no one to care for pets
Wants pet to have daily walks and attention
Needs reliable, trustworthy pet care provider

goals_and_desired_outcomes.primary_goal: Reliable daily pet care that feels like family

buying_signals: Pet developing anxiety from being alone
Moving to the area and needing local services
